name: resizable-navbar
title: Resizable Navbar
description: A top navigation that starts full width and, once the page scrolls, contracts into a narrow blurred capsule holding the logo, links and buttons close together.
use: A marketing page wants a full-width top bar at rest that stays out of the way while reading.
avoid: The desktop bar keeps a hard 800px minimum width, so it crowds tablets and needs the separate mobile parts.
a11y: The mobile toggle is a bare SVG icon with no label or button role, so the mobile menu cannot be opened by keyboard. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark site header with a small logo and wordmark at the left, four grey links centred and two buttons at the right. Scrolled, the same row narrows into a rounded dark pill with a soft shadow.
behaves: After about a hundred pixels of scroll the bar springs inward to forty percent width, drops slightly and gains blur plus a shadow; returning to the top expands it back. Hovering a link slides a grey pill behind it.
customise: Compose Navbar, NavBody, NavItems and the mobile parts; link labels arrive as an items array, while width, blur, shadow and breakpoints are set in the source.
weight: light: A scroll listener drives a few spring properties on one or two bars.
